source_snapshot.title: Thousands pedal into action as Dubai Ride takes over Sheikh Zayed Road
source_snapshot.text: Dubai Ride 2026 is under way, with thousands of cyclists taking to the streets as Sheikh Zayed Road swaps cars for bicycles for this year's edition of the popular community event.Held as part of the opening weekend of the Dubai Fitness Challenge 2026, the free event features two routes: a 12km ride along Sheikh Zayed Road and a 4km family-friendly loop through Downtown Dubai..From Azerbaijan to El Salvador: Dubai Ride 2026 brings together families from across the world.Dubai Ride 2026 in pictures: Thousands cycle along Sheikh Zayed Road.Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here..Participants on the routes will pass some of the city's landmarks, including the Museum of the Future, Dubai Water Canal, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Opera..The Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) has announced temporary closures on three major roads from 3am to 9.30am on Sunday, November 1, to facilitate the event. Motorists have been advised to use alternative routes, including Upper Financial Centre Street, Zabeel Palace Street, Al Wasl Road and Al Khail Road.. Dubai Metro is also operating extended hours, from 3am until midnight, to help participants travel to and from the event.Gulf News wants to see your Dubai Ride moments. Whether you're cycling with family, riding with friends or taking part for the first time, share your pictures and videos with us..Dubai Ride 2026: RTA announces designated car parks for cyclists, here’s where to park on Sunday.Dubai Ride 2026: RTA announces extended Metro hours, parking locations.Dubai Ride: Share your photos with Gulf News.Dubai Ride on Sunday: Where to hire a bike, rental prices and when to get your bib

claims.claim: Dubai Ride 2026 is underway with thousands of cyclists on the streets.
Sheikh Zayed Road is temporarily closed to cars for the event.
The routes include a 12 km ride along Sheikh Zayed Road and a 4 km family loop through Downtown Dubai.
Participants pass landmarks including the Museum of the Future, Dubai Water Canal, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Opera.
Authorities closed three major roads from 3:00 to 9:30 on November 1.
Dubai Metro operates extended hours from 3:00 to midnight for participants.

title: Thousands pedal into action as Dubai Ride takes over Sheikh Zayed Road
summary_ru: 🚴‍♂️ Велопробег Dubai Ride 2026 перекрыл Шейх Зайед Роуд 🚌 В Дубае проходит Dubai Ride 2026: тысячи велосипедистов выехали на улицы, а Шейх Зайед Роуд временно закрыт для автомобилей. Маршруты включают 12 км по главной дороге и 4 км семейный круг по центру города. 📅 Участники проезжают мимо музея будущего, канала Дубай Уотер, Бурдж Халифы и оперы. Власти закрыли три крупных дороги с 3:00 до 9:30 1 ноября, а метро работает с 3:00 до полуночи для удобства участников.
